What does 'git rebase' do?
Git rebase moves your branch's commits on top of another branch, creating a linear history. It rewrites commit hashes, so avoid rebasing branches that others have based work on.

Explain what garbage collection means.
Garbage collection is automatic memory management. The runtime detects objects no longer in use and frees their memory, so you don't have to deallocate manually like in C/C++.

How do I exit a Vim editor?
